### C--Users-jlral-repos-episode-studio  (C:\Users\jlral/.claude/projects\C--Users-jlral-repos-episode-studio\memory)
# Episode Studio — memory index

**Read [Session checkpoint](session-checkpoint.md) FIRST on resume**, and check its date
before trusting a word of it.

*One file, one fact. Descriptions are what recall matches on, so they say what the file
CLAIMS, not what it is about.*

### The state of things
- [Session checkpoint](session-checkpoint.md) — THE live snapshot: in flight / done / waiting / blocked / next. **REWRITTEN 18 Aug 2026 (evening): carries THE GOAL (300 episodes, ~270 to go) and the ordered destination. Batches 1 (`26f340d`) and 2 (`c8db74e`) LANDED. 🔢 THE STANDARD CHANGED — ruling A27 amends §0a-ii: a figure the article's OWN numbers contradict may be corrected via `ebook.corrections[]`, figure-only, with a note. EP30's e-book is rebuilt, gate green, PDF verified — ready to check. 📉 The b-roll fault rate is 1 in 18, not 1 in 4, and it is a LOWER BOUND (EP23 was approved 4/4, published, and its fault found the next day).** Dated; check it.

> **Where the RULES live: `episode-studio/docs/` in the repo, never here and never on Drive.**
> `PP-STANDARDS.md` is the governing standard (the framing ruling is in it);
> `PP-RULINGS.md` is what was decided and why; **`ENGINE-BACKLOG.md` is E1–E28 and what is
> closed (moved out of this silo 6 Aug 2026)**; `docs/EP15/16/17-run-log.md` are the worked
> examples; `docs/landing-queue/README.md` is the worked example of landing frozen-file
> changes. **Memory holds reasoning and rulings — not anything git already records.**
- [The first gate asks for a script, and nothing writes one](the-first-gate-asks-for-a-script-nothing-writes.md) — the finding of the project: the engine automates the BUILD, nothing automates the CREATION. EP14's eleven stops, and which four are one missing thing.

### How to work — earned the hard way, each one recurring
- [Assert the artefact](assert-the-artefact.md) — nine times a proxy was trusted and the thing a human receives was never looked at. Read before writing any check.
- [Fetching a URL measures the EDGE, not the origin](fetching-a-url-measures-the-edge.md) — EP30's re-publish worked and the verifier said it had failed; the quiet direction is "identical" read off a cache while the origin holds something else. Fetch twice, report the two separately.
- [A written warning is not a guard](a-written-warning-is-not-a-guard.md) — EP19 walked into two faults that were already diagnosed in writing, one of them in the docstring directly above the offending call. Fix it or write the failing test; a note is a TODO with no owner.
- [A guard at one funnel says nothing about the other](a-guard-at-one-funnel-says-nothing-about-the-other.md) — A22's ruling said "the single funnel every generated hero comes through" and there were two; the covers got the orientation line, all six of EP25's racing b-roll prompts did not, and the suite was green for a day because every case in it was a fixture.
- [A tick is not a check](a-tick-is-not-a-check.md) — I verified 10.769 against the article's printed 10.7, wrote "✓", and concluded the opposite of what it proved. When a figure is the thing being decided, the check is the RULE, not the resemblance.
- ["All green" means nothing by itself](all-green-means-nothing-by-itself.md) — name the case that proves the fix, or say there isn't one. A suite that never mentions your change is not evidence about it; EP15 died 22 minutes on a "9/9 green" line.
- [One source of truth, or it drifts](one-source-of-truth-or-it-drifts.md) — four times a value lived in two places and the fix reached one reader; and a FIFTH where there was only one copy and it was wrong from birth. **Agreement is not the property you want — provenance is.**
- [Anything that waits must say so](anything-that-waits-must-say-so.md) — waiting and dead look identical unless the waiter says otherwise. Including inside the tool built to fix it.
- [A wrong description of a fault is followed](a-wrong-description-of-a-fault-is-followed.md) — EP25 parked saying "the writer stopped part-way" when the writer had written a COMPLETE script and refused to change it; the wrong words sent the next diagnosis hunting a timeout that never happened.
- [Fold the article and look for surviving digits](fold-the-article-and-look-for-surviving-digits.md) — the one-line check that predicts the numbers gate's next false positive. Run it on any figure-heavy capture BEFORE commissioning; target is NONE.
- [A gate that invites an edit must verify it](a-gate-that-invites-an-edit-must-verify-it.md) — the Words Gate says "change anything" and checks nothing. Editing is sanctioned; not verifying is the fault.
- [Run a guard over every episode before moving it earlier](run-a-guard-over-every-episode-before-moving-it-earlier.md) — moving a check earlier multiplies what being WRONG costs; two of the four guards wired into EP20's commission were wrong, and only a sweep over all 16 shipped files said so.
- [Look at the rendered output](look-at-the-rendered-output.md) — checkers verify structure, not appearance; never trust a green light from a tool you just wrote.
- [A default argument binds at import](a-default-argument-binds-at-import.md) — `pj.PP_VIDEOS = sandbox` does NOT redirect `ep_dir()`; two harnesses believed they were reading a sandbox and were reading the real Drive. Patch the FUNCTION.
- [Command hygiene for permissions](command-hygiene-for-permissions.md) — clever one-liners defeat the "don't ask again" button, so the same prompt recurs forever. One tool, literal paths, or a script file.
- [Un-marking a step does not clear its resume cache](un-marking-a-step-does-not-clear-its-resume-cache.md) — the rewind recipe half-worked: `heygen_download` short-circuits on `jobs.heygen.file`, skipped the trim and the SRT re-align, and shot_map timed the new voice with the old take's leads. **The tell is a step that "re-ran" in one second.**
- [A bad HeyGen take measures perfect](a-bad-heygen-take-measures-perfect.md) — EP20's voice was wrong and loudness, peak, LRA, bitrate and the whole 0–20kHz spectrum matched EP18/19 within 1 dB. **No signal check can catch this; do not build one.** The gap is that nobody hears the GENERATED file (the preview is not it).
- [Two clocks: presenter and final](two-clocks-presenter-and-final.md) — every time in episode.json is PRESENTER-clock and the finished MP4 is 7.0s later; `bs()` is the only crossing point, and the two overlays that skipped it sat 7s before their words while QC made the same error.
- [A field the machine cannot read turns a check OFF](a-field-the-machine-cannot-read-turns-a-check-off.md) — EP18: an absolute path where a relative one was matched made the pre-flight report CLEAN having checked nothing, and hid 8 faults until after seven paid clips. Plus the 1-based checker / 0-based file trap under it.

### Jodie — how she works and what she has ruled
- [A list is not a plan](a-list-is-not-a-plan.md) — she cut a 12–14 day programme to ~3.5 days by asking which items actually caused a fault. Nine halts, three causes. **Read before proposing any plan.**
- [Spend nothing without approval](jodie-spend-nothing-without-approval.md) — stop at the cost boundary and report; she decides before money moves.
- [Show the ground before you change it](jodie-show-the-ground-before-you-change-it.md) — current state first, working shown, gaps named, GUESS marked.
- [Ship it, and who runs what](jodie-ship-it-and-who-runs-what.md) — perfection is the enemy of done; she does board clicks, I run the rail writes.
- [Retention ruling](retention-ruling.md) — cover A/B deleted on publish and logged; rail rows NEVER, because they are the studio's memory; masters never.
- [A shipped episode is not touched](a-shipped-episode-is-not-touched.md) — no rebuild, no re-render **and no file edits**, not even a dormant one-line record. A gate's finding on a shipped episode is logged CLOSED; the fix rides on the next one.
- [Script Gate decision record](script-gate-decision-record.md) — "automation eats chores, never decisions", and the two trade-offs she accepted on purpose.
- [Who may clear a flag](who-clears-a-flag.md) — a flag asking for JUDGEMENT is always hers; a flag reporting a MACHINE FAULT may be cleared by whoever fixed it, on three conditions.
- [A rule with no legal way to comply](a-rule-with-no-legal-way-to-comply.md) — when a gate catches a writer doing something clearly wrong, ask whether the rules left it anywhere else to go. EP26's charts: the gate was right and the vocabulary was the bug.
- [The writer stopping is a FINDING](the-writer-stopping-is-a-finding.md) — EP29 burned all three attempts and was RIGHT all three times; the gate could not say "one dollar fifty". Read the objection before spending the next attempt.
- [Data is lifted, never re-typed](data-is-lifted-never-retyped.md) — a number is a READING, not a value; give the model a SLOT and lift the values in code. **And: a gate is a NET, and a net you plan to land in is a bad plan.**
- [A sweep that only looks where the old rules applied](a-sweep-that-only-looks-where-the-old-rules-applied.md) — widen the real-artefact sweep BEFORE adding a rule, or it can only confirm the rules it was built for. EP26's cover contradiction is what that order caught.
- [A bespoke page has no gate behind it](a-bespoke-page-has-no-gate-behind-it.md) — `block:"bespoke"` skips author_cards AND card_check entirely, so lift the data programmatically, commit the generator, and LOOK at the rendered frame. Hand-authored means unprotected, not licensed.

### The terrain — things that will bite
- [Commissions cost rate limits, not money](commissions-cost-rate-limits-not-money.md) — a headless run comes out of Jodie's Max SUBSCRIPTION, established by reading auth status from a scrubbed spawn. So "can we afford it" is about her ability to work, never a bill. **And `--bare` would silently switch it to new money — the HeyGen trap in a flag that reads as a speed-up.**
- [Drive-only single points of failure](drive-only-single-points-of-failure.md) — a stale Drive clone, a drifted qc_episode.py, and the ungated standing templates.
- [HeyGen render routes](heygen-render-routes.md) — why Gordon's render stays manual: separate money pools, no background parameter, Digital Twins need a real human.
- [Memory silos and the dead checkpoint](memory-silos-and-the-dead-checkpoint.md) — memory is split across 3 folder-keyed silos; always check a checkpoint's date.
- [Why cards cannot be sized at authoring time](shot-map-timing-block.md) — the word-count estimator, measured across 13 episodes and rejected: stdev 4.55s on a ~10s beat.

- [IW house audio standard](iw-house-audio-standard.md) — SIGNED OFF 7 Aug 2026: Louise speed 0.88, breaks 0.7/1.4, 125 wpm pace, music 0.05; all baked into assemble_episode.py
- [Stills + Ken-Burns is the IW video standard](iw-stills-plus-kenburns-is-the-standard.md) — AI clips retired 7 Aug 2026; upscale 2x before zoompan, vary the move
- [IW narration has two clocks](iw-narration-two-clocks.md) — seam 2 reads 4:53 raw but 5:32.7 in the finished file; 64s of pause-stretch sits between them
- [ElevenLabs request stitching](elevenlabs-request-stitching.md) — previous_request_ids SILENTLY overrides previous_text; header is 'request-id', max 3, 2-hour expiry
- [afftdn eats fricatives](afftdn-eats-fricatives.md) — the denoiser destroyed up to 52 dB of single "s" frames; turning it down doesn't help, never denoise TTS
- [Measure at the timescale of the artefact](measure-at-the-timescale-of-the-artefact.md) — I cleared mastering of a fault it caused, by averaging over 4s when the damage was 20ms
- [Break tags make ElevenLabs rush](elevenlabs-break-tags-make-it-rush.md) — longer tags bought 45s of silence but sped the VOICE up 7.7%; ~139 wpm is the floor, tags cap at 3.0s
- [The IW narrator is Valory](iw-narrator-is-valory.md) — Louise RETIRED 9 Aug 2026, the "s→sh" was hers on long text; Valory's speed dial is nearly inert too
- [IWEP074 has no CHAR-B by design](iwep074-has-no-char-b-by-design.md) — Rachel's story has no young-adult scenes; child → painter is the shape, not a gap
- [IW ending standard](iw-ending-standard.md) — last word → 10s story tail → 20s end card; 20s because YouTube only shows end-screen elements in the last 5–20s
- [The safe pause-stretch](iw-safe-pause-stretch.md) — -50 dB + 150 ms guards + an assertion that raises; pace must come from pauses, not the speed dial
